source.title: Breandan Vallance wins World Rubik's Cube Championship 2009
source.content: [Breandan Vallance](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALL01) won the [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2009](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2009) with an average of 10.74 seconds. [Erik Akkersdijk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005AKKE01) finished second (11.52) and [Tomasz Zolnowski](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005ZOLN01) finished third (11.64). World records: Dan Cohen 4x4 36.46 (single), Yumu Tabuchi Rubik's Cube One-handed 16.90 (average), Michal Halczuk 7x7 3:43.15 (single), Piotr Michal Padlewski Square-1 10.96 (single), Bálint Bodor Megaminx 57.94 (single). Asian records: Yumu Tabuchi Rubik's Cube Fewest moves 29 (single), 4x4 blindfolded 8:41.85 (single), Ryosuke Mondo 5x5 blindfolded 26:30.00 (single). European records: Erik Akkersdijk 4x4 39.43 (single), Michal Halczuk 7x7 4:01.23 (average), Piotr Michal Padlewski Square-1 15.21 (average), Rafal Guzewicz 5x5 blindfolded 15:43.00 (single). North American records: Dan Cohen 4x4 46.94 (average), Megaminx 1:20.34 (single) 1:27.30 (average), Timothy Sun Rubik's Cube with feet 58.38 (single). South American records: Pedro Santos Guimarães 4x4 53.30 (single) 1:07.85 (average), Rubik's Cube One-handed 18.27 (single), Megaminx 1:35.77 (average), 4x4 blindfolded 13:09.00 (single), Renan Mondini Cerpe 2x2 3.33 (single).

translation.title: Breandan Vallance 夺得 2009 年世界魔方锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Breandan Vallance](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALL01) 以 10.74 秒的平均成绩夺得 [2009 年世界魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2009)冠军。[Erik Akkersdijk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005AKKE01) 以 11.52 秒获得亚军，[Tomasz Zolnowski](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2005ZOLN01) 以 11.64 秒获得季军。

世界纪录：Dan Cohen，四阶单次 36.46 秒；Yumu Tabuchi，三阶单手平均 16.90 秒；Michal Halczuk，七阶单次 3:43.15；Piotr Michal Padlewski，Square-1 单次 10.96 秒；Bálint Bodor，五魔方单次 57.94 秒。

亚洲纪录：Yumu Tabuchi，三阶最少步单次 29 步、四阶盲拧单次 8:41.85；Ryosuke Mondo，五阶盲拧单次 26:30.00。

欧洲纪录：Erik Akkersdijk，四阶单次 39.43 秒；Michal Halczuk，七阶平均 4:01.23；Piotr Michal Padlewski，Square-1 平均 15.21 秒；Rafal Guzewicz，五阶盲拧单次 15:43.00。

北美洲纪录：Dan Cohen，四阶平均 46.94 秒、五魔方单次 1:20.34、五魔方平均 1:27.30；Timothy Sun，三阶脚拧单次 58.38 秒。

南美洲纪录：Pedro Santos Guimarães，四阶单次 53.30 秒、四阶平均 1:07.85、三阶单手单次 18.27 秒、五魔方平均 1:35.77、四阶盲拧单次 13:09.00；Renan Mondini Cerpe，二阶单次 3.33 秒。
